evidence.claim: Kaiser completed the purchase of Alcoa Warrick LLC; closing date 2021-03-31 (8-K exhibit 99.1, press release dated April 1, 2021)

The acquisition closed on March 31, 2021 and the total purchase price was funded with a combination of existing cash on hand, and the assumption of other post-employment benefits (OPEB) liabilities
